items.uz: Ushbu xat rasmiy murojaat sifatida yuborilmoqda.
items.en: This letter is being sent as a formal petition.

items.uz: Yuqorida ko'rsatilgan shartlarga rioya qilinishi so'raladi.
items.en: Compliance with the above-mentioned terms is requested.

items.uz: Ushbu bitim ikki tomon o'rtasida imzolangan.
items.en: This agreement was signed between the two parties.

items.uz: Barcha huquqiy talablarga muvofiq harakat qilinishi lozim.
items.en: Action must be taken in accordance with all legal requirements.

items.uz: Ushbu qaror qonun kuchiga ega hisoblanadi.
items.en: This decision is considered to have the force of law.

items.uz: Tomonlar o'z majburiyatlarini bajarishga rozilik bildirishdi.
items.en: The parties agreed to fulfill their obligations.

items.uz: Ushbu murojaatga belgilangan muddatda javob berilishi kerak.
items.en: This petition must be responded to within the established period.

items.uz: Rasmiy hujjatlar tegishli idoraga topshirildi.
items.en: The official documents were submitted to the relevant authority.

items.uz: Ushbu band shartnomaning ajralmas qismi hisoblanadi.
items.en: This clause is considered an integral part of the contract.

items.uz: Nizolarni hal qilish uchun huquqiy yo'l tanlandi.
items.en: A legal path was chosen to resolve the disputes.

items.uz: Ushbu qonun loyihasi parlament tomonidan ko'rib chiqilmoqda.
items.en: This draft law is being reviewed by parliament.

items.uz: Har ikki tomon ham kelishuv shartlariga rioya qilishga majbur.
items.en: Both parties are obliged to comply with the terms of the agreement.

items.uz: Haqiqat tushunchasi asrlar davomida bahsli bo'lib kelgan.
items.en: The concept of truth has been debated for centuries.

items.uz: Har bir falsafiy oqim o'ziga xos dunyoqarashni taklif etadi.
items.en: Every philosophical school offers its own worldview.

items.uz: Ong tabiati hali ham to'liq tushunilmagan.
items.en: The nature of consciousness is still not fully understood.

items.uz: Bu savol insoniyatni azaldan qiziqtirib kelgan.
items.en: This question has interested humanity since ancient times.

items.uz: Axloqiy tanlov ko'pincha ziddiyatli vaziyatlarda sinaladi.
items.en: Moral choice is often tested in conflicting situations.

items.uz: Erkin iroda tushunchasi ko'p bahslarga sabab bo'lgan.
items.en: The concept of free will has caused many debates.

items.uz: Har bir mutafakkir haqiqatga o'ziga xos yo'l orqali yetib boradi.
items.en: Every thinker arrives at truth through his/her own path.

items.uz: Bu falsafiy savol aniq javobga ega emas.
items.en: This philosophical question doesn't have a definite answer.

items.uz: Mavjudlik ma'nosi haqidagi savol abadiy ochiq qoladi.
items.en: The question about the meaning of existence remains eternally open.

items.uz: Falsafa insonni chuqurroq mulohaza yuritishga undaydi.
items.en: Philosophy encourages a person to reflect more deeply.

items.uz: Bu nazariya ko'plab zamonaviy mutafakkirlarga ta'sir ko'rsatdi.
items.en: This theory has influenced many modern thinkers.

items.uz: Har bir avlod bu savollarni qaytadan ko'rib chiqadi.
items.en: Every generation reconsiders these questions.
